name: Chol'aruk the Ravener

angles.text: Gur'ak, an orc, calls Horde travelers to hunt a dangerous menace in the Barrens with the battle cry Blood and thunder.
As a Hunter, tracking a beast said to be five times larger than an ordinary quilboar calls for keen instincts and preparation for formidable prey.
As a Warrior, you face a brutal creature with an unquenchable bloodlust. Be ready to brace against its overwhelming physical fury.

faq.answer: The Razormane call Chol'aruk an enormous quilboar known as The Ravener. They say it is roughly five times the size of an ordinary quilboar, thirsts endlessly for blood, and lairs in a deep cave in the Barrens.
Chol'aruk lairs deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of Gur'ak's encampment in the Barrens. Travelers must enter Thorn Hill's caverns to reach it.
Gur'ak, an orc in the Barrens, sends travelers after Chol'aruk. He believes the rumors because he has faced similar beasts before.
faq.q: Who offers the hunt for Chol'aruk?

faq.answer: Gur'ak wants Chol'aruk destroyed because it terrorizes the region. He asks for the beast's severed head as proof that the Ravener has fallen.
Gur'ak warns travelers not to face Chol'aruk alone. Its reported size and bloodlust make it a formidable foe, so he calls for a prepared hunting party.

The Razormane quilboar speak of Chol'aruk with dread and call it The Ravener. The Razormane are a quilboar tribe living in parts of the Barrens, and quilboar are boar-like humanoids native to central Kalimdor.
faq.q: What is the connection between Chol'aruk and the Razormane quilboar?

sections.body: Razormane quilboar whisper of Chol'aruk, an enormous terror they call The Ravener. They say it lairs deep in a cavern at Thorn Hill, northeast of the local trails. By their account, it is roughly five times the size of an ordinary quilboar and driven by an unquenchable thirst for blood. Many dismiss the tales as campfire exaggeration. Gur'ak knows better from past battles with similar beasts.
sections.title: The Legend of the Ravener

sections.body: Gur'ak knows a beast of such size poses a real danger. He directs capable travelers to track Chol'aruk to its lair in Thorn Hill, end its threat, and bring back its head as proof. The Ravener is said to be ferocious and colossal. Gur'ak warns that only well-prepared groups should enter the cave to face it.
sections.title: Gur'ak's Warning

summary: In the Barrens, Gur'ak sends travelers after a colossal quilboar called Chol'aruk the Ravener. He believes the tales and asks them to return with its head.
